analyst.summary: ICICI Prudential AMC is India's largest (or joint-largest) mutual fund house, with AUM, customer count and SIP flows all still growing at healthy double-digit rates and record core operating margins as of the June-2026 quarter. The one weak-looking quarter (Mar-2026) was purely a treasury mark-to-market swing, not a franchise issue. The concern is valuation: the stock trades at roughly double the sector's typical earnings multiple, having listed only in December 2025, which leaves little cushion if markets turn or if new SEBI fee rules squeeze the industry's margins over time. We rate it a Hold -- a good business, fully priced.
